command:
set -euo pipefail
ID=crush005-external-route-go-test-20260913T0753Z
ROOT="$HOME/.cache/frankenstein-crush/$ID"
[ ! -e "$ROOT" ] || { echo SCRATCH_ALREADY_EXISTS; exit 91; }
mkdir -p "$ROOT"
EXPECTED_HEAD=bbca92180f7d11b38b4679d39a1bb79db8918e60
DONOR=d333e04385f9e1d1523cea7b417cb5e8798a713a
GO_SHA=63d339f0da5ab53635a56f2490a7984dfe12dfcff22ad749f63edaf590168445
LIVE_A=$HOME/.claude/star/harness_crush_knopf.sh
LIVE_B=$HOME/.claude/star/harness_crush_knopf.py
LIVE_C=$HOME/.claude/star/harness_crush.py
LIVE_D=$HOME/frankenstein-repo/CRUSH.md
sha256sum "$LIVE_A" "$LIVE_B" "$LIVE_C" "$LIVE_D" > "$ROOT/live.before"
curl -fsSL https://go.dev/dl/go1.27.1.linux-amd64.tar.gz -o "$ROOT/go.tgz"
echo "$GO_SHA  $ROOT/go.tgz" | sha256sum -c -
tar -C "$ROOT" -xzf "$ROOT/go.tgz"
export PATH="$ROOT/go/bin:$PATH"
export GOCACHE="$ROOT/gocache"
export GOMODCACHE="$ROOT/gomodcache"
go version
git clone -q https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush.git "$ROOT/donor"
git -C "$ROOT/donor" checkout -q "$DONOR"
gh repo clone gschaidergabriel/clay-global-research-entity "$ROOT/carrier" -- --filter=blob:none --no-checkout -q
git -C "$ROOT/carrier" fetch -q origin "$EXPECTED_HEAD"
git -C "$ROOT/carrier" checkout -q --detach "$EXPECTED_HEAD"
ACTUAL=$(git -C "$ROOT/carrier" rev-parse HEAD)
[ "$ACTUAL" = "$EXPECTED_HEAD" ] || { echo HEAD_MISMATCH:$ACTUAL; exit 92; }
SEED="$ROOT/carrier/research_entity/coordination/entityos_crush_seed"
mkdir -p "$ROOT/donor/internal/omega"
cp -a "$SEED/internal/omega/." "$ROOT/donor/internal/omega/"
cd "$ROOT/donor"
python3 "$SEED/patch_agent.py"
python3 "$SEED/patch_coordinator.py"
gofmt -w internal/omega internal/agent/agent.go internal/agent/coordinator.go
git diff --check
go test ./internal/omega -count=1
go test ./internal/agent -run '^$' -count=1
sha256sum "$LIVE_A" "$LIVE_B" "$LIVE_C" "$LIVE_D" > "$ROOT/live.after"
cmp -s "$ROOT/live.before" "$ROOT/live.after" || { echo LIVE_HASH_DRIFT; diff -u "$ROOT/live.before" "$ROOT/live.after" || true; exit 93; }
echo CRUSH005_EXTERNAL_ROUTE_VALIDATION_PASS
echo exact_head=$EXPECTED_HEAD
echo donor=$DONOR
cat "$ROOT/live.after"
